definitions.gloss: to ask again; to ask someone to repeat
definitions.explanation: To ask someone to say something again because you didn't hear or understand it the first time.
To respond to a question with another question, turning it back on the person who asked.

examples.japanese: ⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{聞|き}こえなくて→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧{聞|き}き{返|かえ}した。
examples.english: I couldn't hear well, so I asked again.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{小|ちい}さくて→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧、⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{聞|き}き{返|かえ}した。
examples.english: The voice on the phone was quiet, so I asked them to repeat several times.

examples.japanese: {聞|き}き{返|かえ}す⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{恥|は}ずかしくて→恥ずかしい：00843_hazukashii⟧、わかったふり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I was embarrassed to ask again, so I pretended I understood.
When asked "What do you think?", I asked back "What about you?"

examples.japanese: ⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{答|こた}え→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧ず、⟦{逆|ぎゃく}→逆：02649_gyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{聞|き}き{返|かえ}す⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{失礼|しつれい}→失礼：01247_shitsurei⟧だ。
examples.english: It's rude to not answer a question and instead ask one back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{笑|わら}い→笑う：00685_warau⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧{聞|き}き{返|かえ}した。
examples.english: When the reporter asked a pointed question, the minister smiled and asked a question back.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
Godan verb ({五段動詞|ごだんどうし}), transitive. Compound of ⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ + ⟦{返|かえ}す→返す：09648_kaesu⟧. The ～⟦{返|かえ}す→返す：09648_kaesu⟧ pattern means doing something back or again.

USAGE:
Sense 1 is much more common in daily life. Learners of Japanese will frequently need this word when they don't catch what someone said. Polite alternatives include ⟦もう{一度|いちど}→もう一度：02976_mouichido⟧お{願|ねが}いします.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{聞|き}き{返|かえ}す (to ask to repeat many times)
- {聞|き}き{返|かえ}す⟦{勇気|ゆうき}→勇気：02499_yuuki⟧ (the courage to ask again)
